_meta.deliverable: sport profiles - combat, strength & fitness sports
_meta.authority_order: coach round-2 answers (COACH-R2) > round-1 answers (COACH-ANSWER) > everything else
_meta.schema: 04_profiles.json profile schema (field names kept); new fields listed in new_fields; same added fields as sports/team.json so the merge can unify them
_meta.consistency: sports the coach already covered (boxing, MMA, wrestling, BJJ, karate, kickboxing / Muay Thai, powerlifting, CrossFit, bodybuilding / aesthetics, golf, tennis) reuse the 04 v1 weekly-set budgets unchanged; taekwondo and competitive pickleball are small PROPOSED deltas on 04 karate_taekwondo and tennis; new sports get PROPOSED budgets sized like the nearest 04 profile. 04 numbers are only replaced where a round-2 rule is newer (aerobic counts R2-ATH-06, pre-season R2-PER-06, in-season R2-ATH-07, Olympic exposures R2-ATH-04, 60+ R2-ATH-08).

evidence_tags.SCIENCE: external literature or official calendars, cited in references (K-ids)

_meta.unit: working sets per week (04 convention); athletic doses in contacts / throws / cuts / metres; conditioning in sessions per week by colour
_meta.baseline_phase: off-season build week, mid-block (04 convention); season_overrides give pre-season / camp / meet-prep and in-season factors
_meta.stairway: every block climbs in gradual weekly steps (smaller early, slightly bigger after halfway, hardest weeks last, 'start at a 2, end at an 11' = perceived load); no deload or maintenance week inside a block - a block that cannot be finished is cancelled, then maintenance, then a new block (COACH-R2 PER-03/04/05, VOL-07)
_meta.check_in_and_lifestyle: RESOLUTION FLAG: no profile here uses sleep / stress / job / life inputs - the coach rejected them (COACH-R2 GEN-04: 'I just need the workouts'); with no check-in the plan follows its planned stairway (COACH-R2 VOL-03); a check-in step is decided from effort, completion and pain only (the approved R2-VOL-01 table minus its life column)
_meta.effort_scale: effort 10 = 'the max I could do, but successful' (not a fail); a separate 'failed' option may exist (COACH-R2 VOL-02)
_meta.event_driven_sports: combat, strength, physique, HYROX and OCR have no school season: 'pre_season' = camp / meet prep / race-specific block before an event date, 'in_season' = competition-dense weeks; the intake asks the next event date (COACH-R2 GEN-05)
_meta.gen_pop_request: the coach asked for pickleball and HYROX for gen pop ('they want to stay athletic and active'). This file holds the COMPETITIVE versions (pickleball_competitive incl. a 60+ senior variant, hyrox_competitive); the recreational 'stay athletic and active' versions are in sports/genpop-active.json.

off_season: Mon - knee + pull: warm-up -> core 2 x 2 light (COACH-R2 SES-03) -> medball list part 1 (rotational throws, overhead slams, 1 x 10 each - LIB-22) -> ballistic jump (broad jumps / box jumps) -> clean variant (hang clean -> power clean, squat pattern - COACH-R2 ATH-04) -> HEAVY SQUAT (contrast with a jump for L2+ off-season - ATH-12) (axial day 1, COACH-R2 SES-01) + row -> contralateral split squat (level changes) + pull-ups -> towel hangs / farmer holds (grip) -> calves 3 sets

Tue - conditioning first: a real aerobic block (Orange 20-40 min or Green grappling exchanges 35-75 s at ~1:1; ORD-09) -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo (sprawl landings -> level-change hops -> lateral bounds, by Receive-Create stage) -> snatch variant (DB snatch, hinge pattern) -> non-axial hinge (hip thrust / back extension / reverse hyper) + alternating DB press (punching volume high: reduced, not cut - ATH-04) -> single-leg RDL -> neck isometrics 4-way -> rear delts (own sets) -> calves
Wed - MMA practice (striking / wrestling / BJJ); optional Focus / core day (optional days ideally separate - ORD-10)

Thu - knee + pull: core 2 x 2 -> medball list part 2 -> loaded jump (hex-bar / DB jump, 10-20 % body weight - EQ-15) -> clean variant -> belt squat or leg press (non-axial) + single-arm row -> lateral lunge / cossack (UNI-12) -> leg extensions / leg curls -> calves

Fri - conditioning first (Blue striking bursts 12-24 s at 1:3-1:7, a different colour from Tuesday) -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo -> power clean -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) -> unilateral hinge -> sled drag + rear delts -> calves
Sat - sparring; Sun - off; the 3rd (and 4th) aerobic session = the colour not used yet, after practice
pre_season: Camp / pre-competition block: 4-6 weeks at about 60 % of the off-season sets, more speed and power (COACH-R2 PER-06); 3 lifts (Mon / Wed / Fri) around sport sessions
Mon: core 2 x 2 -> medball list (fast) -> ballistic jump -> clean variant 3-5 reps fast -> HEAVY SQUAT 3-5 reps (axial day 1) + row -> contralateral split squat (level changes) -> calves

Wed: real aerobic block first -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo (stage held) -> snatch variant -> belt squat / hip thrust (non-axial) + alternating DB press (punching volume high: reduced, not cut - ATH-04) -> neck isometrics 4-way -> calves
Fri: core 2 x 2 -> medball list -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) + broad jumps -> unilateral hinge -> sled drag + rear delts -> calves
last 1-2 weeks before the event = taper (volume -40-60 %, intensity kept, no new exercises - COACH-R2 PER-06; length modifiable)
in_season: Fight week / dense competition: Mon hard lift, Wed short lift, no lifting on weigh-in or fight day

Hard lift (>= 48 h before a bout / match - COACH-R2 ATH-07 extended, INFERRED): core 2 x 2 -> medball 3-4 throws x 10 -> Olympic light 2 x 3 (hang power clean or DB snatch, COACH-R2 ATH-04) -> squat OR deadlift (alternate weeks; 3-5 reps, RIR 2-3; bilateral kept minimal - UNI-10) + row -> 1 unilateral -> calves
Short lift: core 2 x 2 -> unilateral + upper push / pull 2 sets (pressing reduced, not cut) -> neck + grip
Event week: one short primer early in the week; no lifting on weigh-in or competition day
Aerobic: 2 a week in season (COACH-ANSWER ATH-07) - an Orange flush after bouts / hard sparring + 1 short Blue or Green
post_season: 1-2 weeks: mobility, easy Orange cardio, no athletic work (04 post_season_recovery)
then a maintenance phase of chosen length (extendable); at its end ask: keep maintaining / change the plan / start a training block (COACH-R2 PER-06)
rules: power before strength; horizontal pull before vertical (ORD-01..03); hip-dominant with push, knee-dominant with pull (UNI-11)
up to 12 exercises + the 2-exercise core block (COACH-R2 SES-04); muscles trained that day get 2-4 exercises (COACH-R2 SES-05 - see team.json open question O2)
KB swings are ballistic / athletic and never count as glute volume (COACH-R2 VOL-05)
between blocks the tool may change one detail of a library exercise (hand, grip, stance, implement, range) and show it as a named variation; it never invents exercises (COACH-R2 LIB-01)

every week a step up the stairway (smaller steps early, slightly bigger after halfway, hardest weeks last); no deload or maintenance week inside a block - a block that cannot be finished is cancelled, then maintenance, then a new block (COACH-R2 PER-03/04/05, VOL-07)
with no check-in the plan follows its planned stairway; check-in steps use effort, completion and pain only - no sleep / stress / life inputs (COACH-R2 VOL-03, GEN-04)

box squats ('(D)BOX') to control depth

deep-flexion tolerance built gradually (goblet / belt squat to depth on non-axial days - COACH-R2 SES-02)

a flagged elbow: neutral-grip DB pressing and rows, no straight-arm hanging to failure in tournament weeks (INFERRED)

off_season: Mon - full body A (knee + pull): warm-up -> core 2 x 2 -> medball (rotational slams) -> ballistic jump -> clean variant (hang clean / KB squat clean) -> HEAVY SQUAT (axial day 1) + bent-over row -> split squat + pull-ups (gi / towel pull-ups) -> gi hangs (static grip endurance) -> calves

Wed - full body B (hip + push): real aerobic block first (Orange 20-30 min) -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo / landing (landing + box jumps (mostly ballistic, class 5)) -> snatch variant (KB / DB snatch) -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) + DB bench -> single-leg RDL -> neck isometrics 4-way + rear delts -> calves
Fri - full body C: core 2 x 2 -> medball -> KB squat clean -> belt squat / leg press (non-axial) + single-arm row -> lateral lunge + DB press -> carries (farmer carry) -> biceps / triceps -> calves
Tue / Thu / Sat - BJJ practice; aerobic sessions after practice (one of each colour)
pre_season: Pre-competition block: 4-6 weeks at about 60 % of the off-season sets, more speed and power (COACH-R2 PER-06); 3 lifts around mat practice
Mon: core 2 x 2 -> medball (fast) -> ballistic jump -> clean variant 3-5 reps -> HEAVY SQUAT 3-5 reps (axial day 1) + bent-over row -> gi hangs (static grip endurance) -> calves
Wed: real aerobic block first -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo (stage held) -> snatch variant -> hip thrust / belt squat (non-axial) + DB press -> neck isometrics -> calves
Fri: core 2 x 2 -> medball -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) -> unilateral hinge -> pull-ups -> biceps / triceps -> calves
last 1-2 weeks before the main event = taper (volume -40-60 %, intensity kept, no new exercises - COACH-R2 PER-06)
in_season: Tournament months: Mon hard lift, Wed or Thu short lift, tournaments on weekends

Hard lift (>= 48 h before a match / tournament - COACH-R2 ATH-07 extended, INFERRED): core 2 x 2 -> Olympic light 2 x 3 (hang power clean or DB snatch, COACH-R2 ATH-04) -> squat OR deadlift (alternate weeks; 3-5 reps, RIR 2-3; bilateral minimal - UNI-10) + pull -> 1 unilateral -> grip -> calves
Short lift: core 2 x 2 -> unilateral + push / pull 2 sets -> neck isometrics -> rear delts
Competition day and weigh-in day: no lifting
Aerobic: 2 a week in season (COACH-ANSWER ATH-07) - an Orange flush after matches + 1 short Blue or Green
post_season: 1-2 weeks: mobility, easy Orange cardio, no athletic work (04 post_season_recovery)
then a maintenance phase of chosen length (extendable); at its end ask: keep maintaining / change the plan / start a training block (COACH-R2 PER-06)
rules: power before strength; horizontal pull before vertical (ORD-01..03); hip-dominant with push, knee-dominant with pull (UNI-11)
up to 12 exercises + the 2-exercise core block (COACH-R2 SES-04); muscles trained that day get 2-4 exercises (COACH-R2 SES-05)
pull sets >= push sets every week; grip and neck work 2x/week (no bands - EQ-01)
between blocks the tool may change one detail of a library exercise (hand, grip, stance, implement, range) and show it as a named variation; it never invents exercises (COACH-R2 LIB-01)

every week a step up the stairway (smaller steps early, slightly bigger after halfway, hardest weeks last); no deload or maintenance week inside a block - a block that cannot be finished is cancelled, then maintenance, then a new block (COACH-R2 PER-03/04/05, VOL-07)

off_season: Mon - knee + pull: warm-up -> core 2 x 2 light (COACH-R2 SES-03) -> medball list part 1 (rotational throws both sides, 1 x 10 each - LIB-22) -> ballistic jump (single-leg box jumps / broad jumps) -> clean variant (hang power clean, squat pattern - COACH-R2 ATH-04) -> HEAVY SQUAT (front / goblet squat) (axial day 1, COACH-R2 SES-01) + row -> contralateral split squat + pull-ups -> Copenhagen plank -> calves 3 sets

Tue - conditioning first: a real aerobic block (Orange 20-40 min; ORD-09) -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo (switch-kick hops, skips, rope, by Receive-Create stage) -> snatch variant (DB snatch, hinge pattern) -> non-axial hinge (hip thrust / back extension / reverse hyper) + alternating DB press (reduced, not cut - ATH-04) -> single-leg RDL -> neck isometrics 4-way (clinch) + loaded hip flexion -> rear delts (own sets) -> calves
Wed - Muay Thai / kickboxing practice; optional Focus / core day (optional days ideally separate - ORD-10)

Thu - knee + pull: core 2 x 2 -> medball list part 2 -> loaded jump (hex-bar / DB jump, 10-20 % body weight - EQ-15) -> clean variant -> belt squat or leg press (non-axial) + single-arm row -> lateral lunge / cossack (UNI-12) -> leg extensions / leg curls -> calves

Fri - conditioning first (Green 3-min rounds, a different colour from Tuesday) -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo -> hang power clean -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) -> unilateral hinge -> rear delts + side raises -> calves
Sat - sparring; Sun - off; the 3rd (and 4th) aerobic session = the colour not used yet, after practice
pre_season: Camp / pre-competition block: 4-6 weeks at about 60 % of the off-season sets, more speed and power (COACH-R2 PER-06); 3 lifts (Mon / Wed / Fri) around sport sessions
Mon: core 2 x 2 -> medball list (fast) -> ballistic jump -> clean variant 3-5 reps fast -> HEAVY SQUAT 3-5 reps (axial day 1) + row -> contralateral split squat -> calves

Wed: real aerobic block first -> core 2 x 2 -> plyo (stage held) -> snatch variant -> belt squat / hip thrust (non-axial) + alternating DB press (reduced, not cut - ATH-04) -> neck isometrics 4-way (clinch) + loaded hip flexion -> calves
Fri: core 2 x 2 -> medball list -> HEAVY DEADLIFT / trap bar (axial day 2) + broad jumps -> unilateral hinge -> rear delts + side raises -> calves
last 1-2 weeks before the event = taper (volume -40-60 %, intensity kept, no new exercises - COACH-R2 PER-06; length modifiable)
in_season: Fight week: Mon hard lift, Wed short lift, no lifting on weigh-in or fight day

Hard lift (>= 48 h before a bout / match - COACH-R2 ATH-07 extended, INFERRED): core 2 x 2 -> medball 3-4 throws x 10 -> Olympic light 2 x 3 (hang power clean or DB snatch, COACH-R2 ATH-04) -> squat OR deadlift (alternate weeks; 3-5 reps, RIR 2-3; bilateral kept minimal - UNI-10) + row -> 1 unilateral -> calves
Short lift: core 2 x 2 -> unilateral + upper push / pull 2 sets (pressing reduced, not cut) -> neck + hip flexor
Event week: one short primer early in the week; no lifting on weigh-in or competition day
Aerobic: 2 a week in season (COACH-ANSWER ATH-07) - an Orange flush after bouts / hard sparring + 1 short Blue or Green
post_season: 1-2 weeks: mobility, easy Orange cardio, no athletic work (04 post_season_recovery)
then a maintenance phase of chosen length (extendable); at its end ask: keep maintaining / change the plan / start a training block (COACH-R2 PER-06)
rules: power before strength; horizontal pull before vertical (ORD-01..03); hip-dominant with push, knee-dominant with pull (UNI-11)
up to 12 exercises + the 2-exercise core block (COACH-R2 SES-04); muscles trained that day get 2-4 exercises (COACH-R2 SES-05 - see team.json open question O2)
KB swings are ballistic / athletic and never count as glute volume (COACH-R2 VOL-05)
between blocks the tool may change one detail of a library exercise (hand, grip, stance, implement, range) and show it as a named variation; it never invents exercises (COACH-R2 LIB-01)

every week a step up the stairway (smaller steps early, slightly bigger after halfway, hardest weeks last); no deload or maintenance week inside a block - a block that cannot be finished is cancelled, then maintenance, then a new block (COACH-R2 PER-03/04/05, VOL-07)

Sat - upper dynamic effort: speed bench 'FAST' -> overhead or incline -> pull-ups / rows -> biceps (mixed-grip health - BICEPS_TENDON) -> rear delts
Tue / Fri / Sun - off or easy Orange cardio x 2 (COACH-R2 ATH-06)

rules: anti-rotation static first (Pallof holds BC46-BC49) before rotational dynamic (chops BC9/BC13/BC17, 'Woodchoppers', 'Cable Machine Oblique Rotations')
hip rotation (into/out-of-hip) emphasis so rotation comes from the hips, not the lumbar spine (medball half-kneeling 2x2 matrix)
avoid high-volume loaded flexion+rotation (e.g. weighted Russian twists) when back pain is flagged
lateral hip strength: 'Side Lunges' AL12, 'Step ups (Forward & Side)' AL19, contralateral-loaded lunges
medball half-kneeling scoops labelled 'INTO THE LEFT LEG/HIP' / 'INTO THE RIGHT LEG/HIP' (ballistics MEDBALL CHEAT SHEET D65/D68) both sides
wrist-extensor isometric/eccentric (ISO_GRIP) 2-3x/week
neutral-grip DB pressing

pressing = DB / alternating / landmine ('Kneeling Landmine Press' AA93, 'Sesaw Db Press' AA91, alternating presses AD126-AD129; AD130 is 'Push ups (1 hand Higher)'); heavy barbell overhead only occasionally (the coach writes it 3x in a 24-week baseball year, never in-season); pitchers: less overhead pressing, more arm care, rotational throws kept light (COACH-ANSWER ATH-08)
add ISO_REAR (posterior cuff / 'Bent over DB Reverse flies' AH10, 'Seated DB Reverse Flies' AH15) 2x/week
limit hanging vertical-pull volume to sets that keep 2 RIR (open question: coach)
throwing-day rule: medball rotational OK, overhead slams and plyo push-ups not on bullpen days (INFERRED)

swap fixed-grip barbell/bar -> DB/KB/handles in the same pattern; swap bilateral -> unilateral in the same pattern (MASTER_MODEL athletic A6); keep the sets ideally, 'but you have to adjust accordingly' (UNI-08)
pain moves the bilateral : unilateral share (UNI-02)
'Felt a PAIN' -> swap within the category or lower the level (GEN-05 RIGHT); if twice in a slot: swap, then cut sets, then drop a library level (INFERRED order)
all prehab uses DB, KB, cable, machine, bodyweight or plates - never bands or variable resistance (COACH-ANSWER EQ-01, EQ-12)

60+: no Olympic lifts, plyos or depth jumps by default; offered as an option with 'Make sure that you have a fitness professional to help you understand what this means' (COACH-R2 ATH-08); constrained machines for compounds and isolation (EQ-03)
more than 6-12 months off: the body is treated as L1 (PRG-05)
no rule depends on sex (ATH-09)

off_season: Mon - full body A: warm-up -> core 2 x 2 light (Pallof holds -> chops) -> medball matrix (into / out of each hip, half-kneeling) -> hex-bar jump -> goblet / front squat (axial day 1) + rows -> contralateral 'GET INTO THE HIP' lunges (lead leg) -> calves

Wed - full body B: core -> medball step-back rotational passes -> DB snatch -> trap-bar deadlift (axial day 2) + DB press -> ipsilateral 'GET OUT OF THE HIP' step-ups (trail leg) -> lateral lunges -> grip / wrist extensors -> rear delts
Fri - full body C: core -> CMJ / box jump (RC stage) -> belt squat or leg press (non-axial) + pull-ups -> single-leg RDL + landmine press -> thoracic rotation mobility -> calves
Tue / Thu / Sat - practice / rounds; aerobic 3 (walking 18 holes = Orange)

in_season: tournament weeks: 2 short sessions, none the day before a round (04); hard day >= 48 h before round 1 (COACH-R2 ATH-07 extended)
post_season: 1-2 weeks: mobility, easy Orange cardio, no athletic work (04 post_season_recovery)
then a maintenance phase of chosen length (extendable); at its end ask: keep maintaining / change the plan / start a training block (COACH-R2 PER-06)
rules: rotation trained both directions; anti-rotation static before dynamic (LOW_BACK_ROTATIONAL)
between blocks the tool may change one detail of a library exercise (hand, grip, stance, implement, range) and show it as a named variation; it never invents exercises (COACH-R2 LIB-01)

every week a step up the stairway (smaller steps early, slightly bigger after halfway, hardest weeks last); no deload or maintenance week inside a block - a block that cannot be finished is cancelled, then maintenance, then a new block (COACH-R2 PER-03/04/05, VOL-07)
with no check-in the plan follows its planned stairway; check-in steps use effort, completion and pain only - no sleep / stress / life inputs (COACH-R2 VOL-03, GEN-04)

open_questions.topic: Floor of 10 weekly sets per muscle vs these budgets
open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 VOL-04/06: 'I don't think anybody needs less than 10 sets a week per muscle.' derived.floor_10_check shows that most fighters, court and relative-strength athletes (climbers, gymnasts) sit below 10 for chest, side delts, arms and (with the 0.25 credit of COACH-R2 VOL-05) glutes; the physique budget reused from 04 also shows chest, side delts and arms below 10 before its 12 Focus sets are assigned. Proposed reading (same as team.json O1): the floor applies to muscles a plan trains for size / strength; athletes' pre-season / in-season blocks are maintenance phases; the volume engine (12 / 03) raises physique and gen-pop muscles to the floor and uses Focus sets for priorities. Rear delts keep their approved 4 / 6 / 8 own sets plus helper credit - the tension with the floor is flagged for round 3.
open_questions.status: OPEN - flag to the volume engine owner

open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 SES-01/02: heavy squat and heavy deadlift on two different days, other days non-axial; the approved exception is a light technique squat or deadlift for powerlifters. Weightlifters traditionally squat heavy 2-3x a week. Proposed: heavy back squat day + heavy pull (clean deadlift / pull) day; the front squat stays light-moderate (same exception as powerlifters). Needs the coach.

open_questions.topic: Fight camps vs COACH-R2 PER-06 and the OBSERVED boxing build-up
open_questions.detail: The OBSERVED boxing tab builds weeks 3-8 (+41 % component sets) with a week-7 mini-deload. COACH-R2 VOL-07 removes deloads inside a block, and COACH-R2 PER-06 makes the pre-season block about 60 % of off-season sets with more speed and power + a 1-2-week taper. Resolution used: off-camp = off-season blocks (the 8-week build is the coach's example of one), camp = the 4-6-week pre-season block at about 60 %, then the 1-2-week taper to the fight; the week-7 mini-deload is retired as a default (OBSERVED example only).

open_questions.topic: Aerobic sessions in race-prep blocks (HYROX, OCR)
open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 ATH-06 approved 'pre-season 2' for athletes. HYROX is about 60 % running (K18) and OCR is mostly trail running, so cutting to 2 aerobic sessions before a race would remove the main work. Proposed: HYROX / OCR keep 4 in the race-specific block (3 between races); gym sets still drop to about 60 % (COACH-R2 PER-06).

open_questions.topic: 60+ competitive athletes (senior pickleball, masters lifters, masters grapplers)
open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 ATH-08: 60+ get no Olympic lifts, plyos or depth jumps by default, with an opt-in and the warning 'Make sure that you have a fitness professional to help you understand what this means.' Our round-2 proposal also said landing drills and low ankle hops stay OK; the coach's words say no plyos by default. Profiles use the stricter reading (none by default; balance, step-ups and fast-intent resistance instead). For a masters weightlifter the Olympic lifts are the sport - they opt in with the warning. Confirm both.

04 shared one class (5, 25 %) for karate and taekwondo; the coach approved karate at 25 % (COACH-R2 ATH-01). Taekwondo's bouncing stance and jump / spinning kicks could argue for class 4 (40 %). Kept at class 5 with a slightly higher budget (28 %).

open_questions.topic: ATH-03 group for HYROX and OCR
open_questions.detail: 04 places the hybrid product and distance runners in 'health'. Competitive HYROX / OCR racers are not a health goal. Proposed new group 'hybrid_endurance' (strength-endurance + aerobic) at the merge; until then they use 'health' per the 04 convention.

open_questions.topic: Competitive Olympic weightlifting is its own programming
open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 GEN-06: '% only ... unless you're a competitive Olympic lifter. That becomes a nuance, and now the program needs to change to Olympic weightlifting programming.' The weightlifting profile is a scaffold (4-day snatch / clean & jerk week, % of each lift's 1RM, 1-3 reps on the competition lifts). The coach has not written one - needs his template or approval.

open_questions.topic: Where cleans and snatches sit in the week
open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 ATH-04: cleans read as squat-pattern, snatches as hinge-pattern, up to 4 exposures a week. team.json places cleans on knee days and snatches on hip days; the coach's own CrossFit split (OBSERVED) puts snatches on both lower days (Mon knee dom, Thu hip dom) and cleans on the upper days. Both are used here (team convention for athletes, OBSERVED split for CrossFit). Is the pattern a day-placement rule or only a balance rule?

In the OBSERVED class split only the strength / power slots are sets (about 15 a week); the WOD carries most of the work but is conditioning (VOL-10 logic), so every muscle sits below 10. Options: count WOD resistance movements at a fraction, or add a RESISTANCE slot (the FULL / HALF TIME tables have 'RESISTANCE LVL 1 = 2 SETS x 10'). This matters for the 'CrossFit-style bootcamp' sample plan the coach will grade (COACH-R2 GEN-07).

open_questions.topic: Physique contest prep and peak week
open_questions.detail: Proposed: prep = 1-2 full blocks (no deload inside, COACH-R2 VOL-07) at about 90 % of off-season sets with longer cardio and daily walks; peak week about -45 %, no new exercises. The tool gives no nutrition, water or posing-schedule advice (COACH-R2 GEN-04: workouts only). Division priority deltas (bikini glutes / shoulders, men's physique V-taper, wellness lower body) are PROPOSED.

open_questions.detail: Hangboard (finger strength, climbing), neck 4-way isometrics (wrestling, judo, MMA, Muay Thai - 04 library gap), carries / drags exercises (CARRY / DRAGS columns are empty - LIB-19: strongman, HYROX, OCR), sled push / pull and wall balls (HYROX), rope climb / dead hang / monkey bars (OCR), handstand push-up progression and parallette holds (gymnastics), log / axle / yoke / stones (strongman). open_questions.detail: COACH-R2 SES-02 lists the axial lifts; strongman implements are not on it. The yoke produces the highest spine loads of the events studied (K14), so it is treated as axial and shares the squat day; heavy farmers share the deadlift day (INFERRED).

references.claim: Wrestling technical-tactical and physiological demands review (Miarka 2016): after the 2013 rule change bouts show quicker, more varied actions; decisive actions in standing and ground positions
Greco-Roman World Championship time-motion (Nilsson et al. 2002, J Sports Sci): mean work 37.2 s / rest 13.8 s (~3:1); blood lactate ~14.8 mmol/L
High-school vs college wrestling injuries (Yard et al. 2008, AJSM): 2.33 vs 7.25 injuries / 1000 AE; matches riskier than practice at both levels
Example state high-school wrestling calendar (TSSAA, Tennessee) - winter season, state tournament in February
Secondary summary of NFHS / NCAA wrestling season dates (NCAA championships third weekend of March)
Judo combat time-motion and physiology (Franchini, Artioli & Brito 2013): effort:pause 2:1-3:1 with 20-30 s efforts and ~10 s pauses
Judo time-motion by championship phase, 53,403 actions (J Hum Kinet 2018)
Epidemiology of injuries during judo tournaments (Translational Sports Medicine 2023): sprains, contusions, lacerations; knee, shoulder, elbow and fingers among the main sites
Injuries in judo: systematic review with prevention suggestions (BJSM 2013) - top-level competition: knee ~17 %, shoulder ~16 %, elbow ~14 %; being thrown the main mechanism
BJJ matches of 2-10 min (Andreato et al. 2017, Kinesiology): effort:pause ratio stable across durations; longer matches add pause time, lower grip-strength endurance and raise RPE
Female high-level BJJ time-motion by weight division (Frontiers in Psychology 2023)
